statement: A Rule 506(c) offering may use general solicitation only if all purchasers are accredited investors and the issuer takes reasonable steps to verify their accredited status, such as reviewing tax or asset documentation or obtaining written confirmation from a registered professional (17 CFR § 230.506(c)(2)(i)-(ii)).
caveat: Self-certification alone is generally insufficient verification under 506(c), unlike 506(b). Publicly announcing a raise (including on social media) before choosing an exemption can foreclose 506(b). This repo does not assess verification adequacy.
